title: MS17-010 (EternalBlue)
description: EternalBlue exploits a vulnerability in Microsoft's SMBv1 server handling to enable remote code execution without authentication. An attacker can send specially crafted packets to a vulnerable SMBv1 service which can result in arbitrary code execution, often leading to full system compromise and rapid worm-like propagation.
businessImpact: High --- exploitation can enable ransomware propagation (e.g. WannaCry), lateral movement and privilege escalation, operational downtime for critical systems, and regulatory/compliance exposure (data breaches leading to fines or reporting requirements).
remediation:
- Apply Microsoft security updates that address MS17-010 to all affected Windows systems.
- Disable SMBv1 protocol across the environment unless absolutely required.
- Use automated vulnerability scanning to discover systems still vulnerable to CVE-2017-0144.
- Apply network segmentation and firewall rules to restrict SMB/TCP 139 and 445 to only necessary hosts.
- Maintain an inventory of Windows hosts and enforce timely patch management.
